gloss: to accomplish; to achieve; to carry out

definitions.gloss: to accomplish; to achieve; to carry out to completion
definitions.explanation: To see something through to the end, to bring an endeavor or process to completion. Often used for significant achievements or transformations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遂|と}げる。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遂|と}げた。

⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、ついに⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遂|と}げること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: After years of effort, I was finally able to fulfill my dream.

notes:
{遂|と}げる is a transitive ichidan verb with a literary, formal tone. It emphasizes completion and finality.

ASPECT (ている):
Rarely used in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form. The focus is on the completed result rather than an ongoing state.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遂|と}げる (accomplish A)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遂|と}げる (accomplish an objective)
- ⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遂|と}げる (achieve growth)
- ⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遂|と}げる (achieve development)
- ⟦{変貌|へんぼう}→変貌：12117_henbou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遂|と}げる (undergo a transformation)
- ⟦{進化|しんか}→進化：06029_shinka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遂|と}げる (achieve an evolution)

Also appears in the compound verb {成|な}し{遂|と}げる (to accomplish, to achieve), which is even more emphatic. The expression ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遂|と}げる means "to meet one's death" (literary).
